intro: ITrackZen brings vehicles, drivers, fuel, maintenance and reports into one clear dashboard. Whether you manage ten vehicles or thousands, you see what is happening now and have the records to plan what comes next.

benefits.title: Lower fuel and running costs
benefits.text: Spot idling, detours and fuel loss early and set realistic consumption targets per vehicle.

benefits.title: Safer drivers, fewer accidents
benefits.text: Behaviour scoring and alerts encourage safer habits and reduce risk and insurance claims.

benefits.title: Higher vehicle utilisation
benefits.text: See which vehicles are underused so you can plan jobs and routes more efficiently.

benefits.title: Theft and misuse prevention
benefits.text: Geofences, ignition alerts and engine cut-off support protect vehicles and cargo.

benefits.title: Reliable delivery times
benefits.text: Live positions and route history help dispatch, customer updates and proof of service.

benefits.title: Audit-ready records
benefits.text: Keep trip, fuel and maintenance history ready for managers, customers and auditors.

modules.title: Live map & vehicle list
modules.text: Search, group and filter vehicles, view status at a glance and open details in one click.

modules.title: Driver management
modules.text: Assign drivers with RFID / iButton, track behaviour scores and compare performance.

modules.title: Fuel centre
modules.text: Fuel level charts, consumption per trip and automatic alerts for sudden fuel drops.

modules.title: Maintenance planner
modules.text: Service reminders by distance, engine hours or date, with history for every vehicle.

modules.title: Alerts centre
modules.text: Overspeed, geofence, ignition, route deviation, SOS and sensor alerts in one place.

modules.title: Reports & exports
modules.text: Trip, stop, fuel, driver and summary reports on demand or on a schedule.

modules.title: Users & roles
modules.text: Give managers, dispatchers and customers the exact access they need and nothing more.

modules.title: Geofence manager
modules.text: Create zones for depots, ports, borders, customers and restricted areas.

steps.title: Connect vehicles
steps.text: Add trackers and sensors to your vehicles, or connect compatible devices you already own.

steps.title: Configure rules
steps.text: Set speed limits, geofences, working hours and alert recipients for each group.

steps.title: Operate from one view
steps.text: Dispatch, monitor and respond using the live map, alerts centre and mobile access.

steps.title: Review and improve
steps.text: Use reports and driver scores to coach teams, cut costs and plan maintenance.
